verdict.rationale: Mercury describes the full accounting API and MCP layer only as coming "Soon", and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404, so there is no shipped API for posting journal entries. The built-in Command assistant can write journal entries and accountants can be invited, but that is an in-product feature rather than API access by the user's own agent. No draft or review queue for journal entries is documented.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent draft and post journal entries via the API and leave them in a review queue for my accountant
